observation_nodes.label: Professor Tealeaf
observation_nodes.description: A trusted city contact at the Wizard’s College whom the group intended to message for help regarding problems contacting Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Frank
observation_nodes.description: A city contact who had possession of the rockie-talkie before Grobnok took it, suggesting possible compromise.

observation_nodes.label: Sara
observation_nodes.description: A person in Mirathorn whom Grobnok had not seen recently amid the city's corruption outbreak.

observation_nodes.label: Commander Vale
observation_nodes.description: A Mirathorn commander whom Private Hester advised the group to speak with before entering the swamp.

observation_nodes.label: Private Hester
observation_nodes.description: An Elderwild Reach soldier carrying reports for Mirathorn who warned the party about mysterious music, people walking into the swamp, and the need for a larger force.

observation_nodes.label: Dustwalker
observation_nodes.description: A festival performer whose song was later recognized as the same rhythmic melody the group found themselves humming.

observation_nodes.label: Shepherd
observation_nodes.description: A cult-related figure or role being openly recruited for within the city, associated with the ongoing corruption problem.

observation_nodes.label: Lysandro
observation_nodes.description: Lysandra's father, encountered at the guarded wall at the end of the session.

observation_nodes.label: Mireward Road
observation_nodes.description: The road/travel route leading north toward Mireward, used by the group during their journey through the Reach.

observation_nodes.label: Golden Fields
observation_nodes.description: The vast northern reach the group focuses on during the journey.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn
observation_nodes.description: A city to the south/back along the route; the group considers a multiday return journey there and attempts to contact it during the session.

observation_nodes.label: Mireward
observation_nodes.description: Northern destination city/town referenced as the group’s onward destination and later estimated to be about 20 miles north.

observation_nodes.label: Wizard’s College
observation_nodes.description: A location within the city context that the group considers contacting Professor Tealeaf through, believed to be relatively unaffected.

observation_nodes.label: Abandoned restaurant at the road fork
observation_nodes.description: A small building along the road at a fork, later revealed to be an abandoned restaurant specializing in meat on a stick; the group shelters here during the hailstorm.

observation_nodes.label: Storage area
observation_nodes.description: A small storage space below the restaurant’s trapdoor where old skewers with graying meat are found.

observation_nodes.label: the Reach
observation_nodes.description: The broader region the group turns their focus to at the start of the session, associated with the Golden Fields to the north.

observation_nodes.label: Elderwild Reach
observation_nodes.description: The military region identified by Private Hester’s uniform.

observation_nodes.label: the swamp
observation_nodes.description: The destination the council instructs the group to continue toward as the likely source of the problem.

observation_nodes.label: fork in the road
observation_nodes.description: A road fork where a small building and a directional sign are encountered; the sign points toward Mireward.

observation_nodes.label: Mireward 20 miles north sign
observation_nodes.description: A roadside directional sign at the fork indicating Mireward is 20 miles north.

observation_nodes.label: wall checkpoint
observation_nodes.description: A wall in the darkness with a guard standing watch where the group is stopped and asked to identify themselves.

observation_nodes.label: Questionable Company
observation_nodes.description: The party of adventurers traveling together during Session 22, treated here as a collective faction/party anchor.

observation_nodes.label: Wizard’s College
observation_nodes.description: Institution in Mirathorn believed by the party to be a relatively trustworthy place to send a message through Professor Tealeaf.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn council
observation_nodes.description: The city governing council coordinating responses to the outbreak, mercenaries, and contact with the group.

observation_nodes.label: City guard of Mirathorn
observation_nodes.description: Mirathorn’s guard force, described as decimated and further reduced by corruption during the outbreak.

observation_nodes.label: Mercenaries hired by the council
observation_nodes.description: Mercenary group hired by the Mirathorn council after the city guard was reduced by corruption.

observation_nodes.label: Elderwild Reach
observation_nodes.description: Regional military or administrative authority whose uniform is recognized on Private Hester.

observation_nodes.label: the meat heads
observation_nodes.description: A faction in Mirathorn associated with the corruption outbreak and increasingly open recruitment for the Shepherd.

observation_nodes.label: the Shepherd
observation_nodes.description: The cult referenced as the source of recruitment activity and the problem the group is instructed to destroy.

observation_nodes.label: Private Hester's military unit
observation_nodes.description: A military unit implied by Private Hester’s Elderwild Reach uniform and her duty carrying reports to Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: the Golden Fields
observation_nodes.description: A named region to the north serving as the party’s directional reference point on the road.

observation_nodes.label: silver raven
observation_nodes.description: A messenger device used to send a spoken and written message toward Professor Tealeaf and Grobnok; it would take the rest of the day to arrive.

observation_nodes.label: rockie-talkie
observation_nodes.description: A communication device used repeatedly to contact Mirathorn and later receive updates from Grobnok.

observation_nodes.label: sealed tube
observation_nodes.description: A sealed tube carried by Private Hester containing reports for Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Whisper Bottle
observation_nodes.description: A magical focus used by Caelynn to cast Detect Magic when investigating the puddles.

observation_nodes.label: vial
observation_nodes.description: A vial examined by Stafl with Identify; it was determined not to be safe to drink and was associated with conjuration/planar bleed.

observation_nodes.label: chalkboard menu
observation_nodes.description: An abandoned restaurant sign whose menu had been hastily erased and rewritten with the message 'headed south, north wrong'.

observation_nodes.label: trapdoor
observation_nodes.description: A trapdoor inside the abandoned restaurant leading to a small storage area.

observation_nodes.label: jar of skewers with old graying meat
observation_nodes.description: A jar found in the restaurant storage area containing a few skewers with old graying meat.

observation_nodes.label: Delayed reflections in puddles
observation_nodes.description: Puddles along the road show reflections that lag a second behind what they mirror, suggesting an unusual magical distortion or planar bleed in the area.

observation_nodes.label: Conjuration bleed from another plane
observation_nodes.description: Detect Magic and later arcana checks indicate the puddle phenomenon is conjuration-based and may be a bleed from another plane of existence, with an unknown source actively conjuring it.

observation_nodes.label: Storm convergence and incoming hail wall
observation_nodes.description: Multiple storms appear to be converging from the west and south, eventually revealing a massive hail storm that forces the group to shelter and suggests dangerous weather escalation.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn communications failure
observation_nodes.description: Repeated attempts to contact Mirathorn fail, forcing the group to rely on indirect communication through trusted contacts and a silver raven message.

observation_nodes.label: City corruption outbreak and compromised figures
observation_nodes.description: Grobnok reports a renewed outbreak of corrupted meat, decimated city guards, compromised Frank, and Sara missing, implying an unresolved internal crisis in Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Mysterious music drawing people into the swamp
observation_nodes.description: Reports from Private Hester and later group observations point to strange music influencing people to walk into the swamp without responding when stopped.

observation_nodes.label: Shared humming of the Dustwalker song
observation_nodes.description: The party independently begins humming the same song, identified as the rhythm heard the previous night and the Dustwalker’s festival performance, suggesting an active enchantment or lingering influence.

observation_nodes.label: Recently abandoned restaurant with cryptic sign
observation_nodes.description: An abandoned meat-on-a-stick restaurant appears to have been vacated within the past week, with its menu erased and replaced by the message 'headed south, north wrong,' implying a recent warning or forced evacuation.

observation_nodes.label: Knocking on a door that cannot be found
observation_nodes.description: Karsemine hears knocking on a door after the storm, but cannot locate any source or even find a door, indicating a potentially supernatural or illusory phenomenon.

observation_nodes.label: Shepherd cult recruitment inside the city
observation_nodes.description: The 'meat heads' are becoming more open in recruiting for the Shepherd, and a gnome now shows shimmering eyes despite that infection pattern previously being associated only with humans.

observation_nodes.label: Lysandra's true mission and leadership resolve
observation_nodes.description: Under magical questioning, Lysandra states her intention is to keep the team focused on reaching the swamp and destroying the cult source, but her broader motivations and fit as leader remain under scrutiny.

observation_nodes.label: Lysandro encountered at the wall
observation_nodes.description: The party reaches a guarded wall at night and meets a man identified as Lysandra's father, Lysandro, creating a new personal and political connection at the boundary.

ignored_items.label: Generic travel and camp logistics
ignored_items.reason: Routine wagon travel, camping setup, watch rotation, and weather commentary are incidental unless tied to a mystery or unresolved consequence.

ignored_items.label: Minor character banter and morale updates
ignored_items.reason: Private conversations, jokes, and mood-setting dialogue do not constitute a thread-level unresolved phenomenon on their own.

deferred_items.label: Origin and mechanics of the delayed reflections
deferred_items.reason: The session identifies a conjuration-linked anomaly but does not resolve its source, scope, or purpose.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Investigate the area for planar markers, recurring locations, or a caster/source tied to the puddles.

deferred_items.label: Identity and role of the Shepherd
deferred_items.reason: The cult’s recruitment and influence are escalating, but the organization’s structure and leadership remain unresolved in this recap.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Track city reports, interview survivors, and correlate infected individuals with Shepherd activity.

deferred_items.label: Cause of the shared humming/song influence
deferred_items.reason: The song is identified, but the mechanism by which it spreads or affects the party is not explained.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Compare the melody to prior performances and test whether proximity, memory, or magical compulsion is triggering it.

deferred_items.label: Meaning of the abandoned restaurant warning
deferred_items.reason: The cryptic sign suggests danger or directional instruction, but its authorship and intended meaning are unknown.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Search for survivors, tracks, or other abandoned sites that repeat the same phrasing.

deferred_items.label: Who or what is knocking on the unseen door
deferred_items.reason: The knocking is unresolved and may represent a supernatural event, illusion, or nearby hidden structure.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Revisit the area with magical detection or tracking during similar conditions.

deferred_items.label: Identity and intentions of Lysandro
deferred_items.reason: A new personal connection is introduced abruptly, but his role in the broader conflict is not yet defined.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Follow up on Lysandro’s relationship to the wall settlement, Lysandra, and the swamp-bound mission.

observation_beats.title: Route shifts toward the Reach and Mireward
observation_beats.summary: The group pivots from Mirathorn to the northern Reach and prepares to continue toward Mireward, with an ominous storm system already building around them and a damp, magical trail underfoot.

observation_beats.title: Failed city contact leads to a new messaging plan
observation_beats.summary: After another unsuccessful attempt to reach Mirathorn, the party decides to contact trusted intermediaries instead: Professor Tealeaf, and Grobnok with an encoded backup message, sent by silver raven.

observation_beats.title: Travel reveals magical anomalies and social tension
observation_beats.summary: On the road, the storm worsens and the party notices delayed reflections in puddles. Their conversation also surfaces distrust and personal tensions, especially around lies and Lysandra.

observation_beats.title: Private Hester warns of swamp corruption
observation_beats.summary: The group meets Private Hester, a Reach soldier carrying reports to Mirathorn. She reports mysterious music, people walking into the swamp unresponsive, and warns that a much larger force may be needed before urging them to speak to Commander Vale.

observation_beats.title: Puddle magic is investigated at camp
observation_beats.summary: While searching for camp, the party studies the strange puddles. Caelynn detects conjuration magic and they briefly test the water, but nothing changes, so they continue looking for a safe place to stop.

observation_beats.title: Grobnok confirms the city crisis has worsened
observation_beats.summary: At camp, the vial is analyzed and the puddle phenomenon is interpreted as planar bleed or conjuration. Grobnok then contacts the group to report renewed corruption outbreaks in the city, compromised personnel, mercenaries on hire, and instructions to continue to the swamp while he remains the sole point of contact.

observation_beats.title: Night watch reveals storm, mist, and a hum
observation_beats.summary: The party endures a quiet night until a familiar savory mist rises at dawn. With no further contact from Grobnok, they set out again and learn that the approaching weather has become a major hailstorm, prompting a hurry for shelter.

observation_beats.title: Morale lifts, and the shared song is recognized
observation_beats.summary: The journey becomes more upbeat, and Lysandra admits to Ephanna that she is struggling with leadership. The group then notices they are all humming the same tune, which is identified as the Dustwalker’s festival song, before reaching the Mireward fork.

observation_beats.title: Abandoned restaurant provides shelter from hail
observation_beats.summary: The party inspects a recently abandoned meat-on-a-stick restaurant, finds signs of a hurried departure, and shelters there as Karsemine reinforces the structure. A massive hail wall hits and then passes.

observation_beats.title: A door-knock omen and another troubling city update
observation_beats.summary: After the storm, the group resumes travel and hears unexplained knocking with no visible source. Ephanna then receives another Grobnok call reporting an unstable truce in the city, growing Shepherd recruitment, and a gnome showing shimmering eyes.

observation_beats.title: Lysandra’s stated mission and a guarded wall ahead
observation_beats.summary: Stafl uses Suggestion to probe Lysandra’s intentions, and she says she wants the team focused on reaching the swamp and destroying the cult source. Soon after, the party finds a wall and a guard who demands identification.

observation_beats.title: The guard is revealed as Lysandra’s father
observation_beats.summary: Once the guard gets a better look at the party, he recognizes Lysandra as his daughter, revealing himself to be Lysandro and reintroducing the family connection in the scene.
